user.title: Sign in to TransportMe
user.description:
**Step 1 —** Open the sign-in page and authenticate with your TransportMe account:

[Open TransportMe sign-in]({auth_url})

**Step 2 —** After you see the "Signed in successfully" message, return here and click **Submit**.

error.auth_not_completed: Please open the sign-in link above and complete sign-in before clicking Submit.

abort.already_configured: This TransportMe account is already configured.
